extDescription.message: Saves the current web page or a YouTube video with its transcript as a note in Live Notes.

cmdSave.message: Save the current tab to Live Notes

notifyStillRunning.message: “$TITLE$” is still being processed in the app.

errNotRunning.message: Live Notes is not running or its browser interface is turned off. Start the app and try again.

errUnauthorized.message: The token is missing or wrong. Copy it from Live Notes (Settings → Browser extension) into the extension settings.

errForbidden.message: Live Notes refused the request (403). Is the extension up to date?

errTooLarge.message: This page is too large to save.

errDisabled.message: The browser interface is turned off in Live Notes.

errJobLost.message: Live Notes no longer knows this job (app restarted?).

errBadSettings.message: Invalid port in the extension settings.

optIntro.message: You find the token in Live Notes under Settings → Browser extension.

optPermission.message: The extension is not yet allowed to reach Live Notes on 127.0.0.1.

optShortcut.message: Shortcut: Alt+Shift+L (change it in about:addons → gear menu → Manage Extension Shortcuts).
